post_ot_fatigue_on_production.classification_evidence: Opener primary (week-blocked): -0.219 accuracy points, P+=0.38375, interval crosses zero on both sides. Neither terminal ground applies: wrong_sign_resolved requires the whole interval on the wrong side (it does not), and no_split_half_reliability is inadmissible by construction -- post_ot_fatigue_flag is a deterministic function of the published schedule (whether a team's immediately preceding in-season game reached overtime), with zero measurement noise to split in half (docs/schedule_flag_battery.md section 1). The +44.298-point positive control (candidate column replaced by realized ats_margin) demonstrates the harness can detect an effect of that size but does not bound THIS effect to a known small ceiling. Therefore unresolved_below_power.
post_ot_fatigue_on_production.description: Opener-grade confirmation: predeclared post-overtime fatigue flag (signed +1 away team's immediately preceding in-season game went to OT and home's did not, -1 reverse, 0 both/neither) on top of production weak_stack versus production unmodified, paired forced-pick probability-rule accuracy.
post_ot_fatigue_on_production.plain_summary: Fading whichever team just came off an overtime game did not clearly help or hurt picks on this two-season card; the result leans slightly negative but is far from conclusive.
